program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (17.0, 12.0, 22.0),
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.4, 2.0),
    "Itail": (30e-6, 16e-6, 50e-6),
    "I7":    (120e-6, 70e-6, 140e-6),
    "gmidp": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "gmidn": (16.0, 12.0, 20.0),
    "Ln":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),
    "Cc":    (0.9e-12, 0.4e-12, 2e-12),
    "rzk":   (2.0, 1.0, 5.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It = p["Itail"]; I7 = p["I7"]; Cc = p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2
    gmidn = p["gmidn"]; Ln = p["Ln"]
    gmidp = p["gmidp"]; Lp = p["Lp"]
    # NMOS pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS mirror load and 2nd-stage PMOS: same gm/Id and L -> matched density, zero systematic offset
    m3 = lut.size("p", gmidp, Lp, I1, vds=0.9)
    m7 = lut.size("p", gmidp, Lp, I7, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias mirrors (same gm/Id, same L as reference)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn, Ln, iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmidn, Ln, It, vds=0.2)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidn, Ln, I7, vds=0.9)
    gm7 = m7.gm
    Rz = p["rzk"] / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> vinp non-inverting through PMOS CS stage
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    Cout = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + Cout * Cc + C1 * Cout))
    rz_eff = Rz - 1.0 / gm7
    zterm = math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw * 2 * PI * Cc * rz_eff)) if rz_eff > 0 else 0.0
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + zterm - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    pm = min(pm, 90)
    cmrr = A1 * 2 * m3.gm / max(mt.gds, 1e-12)
    psrr = A1 * A2 / 2.0
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I7)
    settle = 0.6 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.7)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    vn_th = math.sqrt(16.0 / 3.0 * kT / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise = vn_th * 10
    swing = 1.8 - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.05
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
               "psrr_db": db(psrr), "slew": slew, "power": power, "settle": settle,
               "noise_1k": noise, "swing": swing}
